_comment: Baseline of transmission_units/drivetrain_systems groups that share (maker, family, speeds) / (type, maker) but were reviewed and confirmed DISTINCT -- not duplicates -- by Martin after the Part 1 reference-data audit (2026-10-08). validate-template.mjs's gearbox/drivetrain near-duplicate safety net (maker non-null groups only) treats any group matching one of these code-sets as already-reviewed and skips it; a NEW group not listed here is an ERROR requiring the same review before being added here. Codes are stored sorted so membership comparison doesn't depend on live query order.
